title: SentenceTransfomer tokenizer result is not consistent with tokenize reuslt in encode
author: swordow

comments.author: tomaarsen
comments.body:
Hello!

Indeed, the Transformer module will strip inputs from whitespace at the start and end. I think this is indeed the cause of the discrepancy that you're seeing. I wish I could remove this and defer this kind of functionality to the `transformers` tokenizer, but removing this line would (slightly) break backwards compatibility: I don't want to push updates that change the outputs of the same `model.encode("blabla")`.

- Tom Aarsen
